senses.definition: n.pr.m. (my father is help)—= אִיעֶזֶר Nu 26:30—
a Manassite, called ‘son’ of Gilead Nu 26:30 (cf. Di) Jos 17:2 Ju 6:34; 8:2; and son of Gil.’s sister 1 Ch 7:18.
a Benjamite, a warrior of David 2 S 23:27 1 Ch 11:28; 27:12.
